provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Power Grid rules (2F-Spiele / Rio Grande, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Choose a map side (first game: Germany) and a connected playing zone of {n} areas
Fill the resource market: coal on spaces 1-8, oil 3-8, garbage 6-8, uranium 14-16
Other resource tokens and the money by the board; the resource refill card for your player count beside the market
Shuffle the plug-backed power plants (03-15); draw 8 faceup: the 4 smallest in the top row (current market), the other 4 below (future market), each row ascending
Set 1 more plug-backed power plant aside facedown
Each player: 22 houses, {n} Elektro and a payment summary card
One house on 0 of the scoring track; one house each drawn at random onto the player order track
Whenever a plant is added, re-sort the market so the 4 cheapest are the current market
Auction power plants in player order; each player may buy at most 1 per round
